tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Slide and page ground. Krem for most content; Malam for night-time topics and Seri Ayah Baru hooks.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Soft corner blobs and quiet panels on surface-100. Decoration only, never behind text that needs contrast.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards and frames that sit on surface-100.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, the ring around a cream avatar.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: hooks, titles, tips text. 10:1 on surface-100.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy, sub-lines, the handle. 4.6:1 on surface-100 light; use only on surface-100 or surface-card.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: The T (parent) leaves in the logo; leaf motifs; divider rules under titles. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: sage-deep
tokens.usage: The T stem; the 'T' of the wordmark; avatar circle; borders of tips boxes. As text only at 24px and up (3.6:1 on krem).

tokens.name: sage-ink
tokens.usage: Text on sage-tint (the COBA INI label); fill of the kicker chip with on-accent text. 5:1 on sage-tint.

tokens.name: sage-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the tips box (COBA INI) and other practical, do-this-now panels.

tokens.name: terra
tokens.usage: The t (child) leaves; the active page dot; rules under hooks; heart and sparkle motifs. Fill only on krem: 2.8:1, never text and never behind text.

tokens.name: terra-deep
tokens.usage: The t stem; the second 'T' of the wordmark; CTA pill fill. Text only at 24px and up on krem (3.8:1).

tokens.name: terra-ink
tokens.usage: Text on blush: hearts and labels inside blush discs on CTA slides. 5:1 on blush.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: The disc behind the CTA motif; soft terracotta panels. Stays light on the Malam ground too.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The bud and the ground line in the logo; suns, stars, moons. On Malam it is also the accent text colour (7.5:1). Never text on krem.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The Malam ground as a fixed colour, for blocks and frames that must stay dark in either theme.

tokens.name: deep-block
tokens.usage: Large dark colour blocks on covers and panels; lifts one step off the Malam ground so it never disappears.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: The one highlighted word in a hook, the swipe cue, accent lines in a CTA. Display sizes only.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on terra-deep and sage-ink fills (CTA pill, kicker chip).

tokens.name: dot-inactive
tokens.usage: Inactive page dots in the slide footer.

tokens.name: seri-pintar-bg
tokens.usage: Seri Anak Pintar: tag chip and slide-number disc. Sage, the parent colour: development is what parents steer.

tokens.name: seri-pintar-ink
tokens.usage: Seri Anak Pintar: text and lightbulb icon on seri-pintar-bg (5.1:1).

tokens.name: seri-mpasi-bg
tokens.usage: Seri MPASI: tag chip and slide-number disc. Warm yellow, like food and the sun.

tokens.name: seri-mpasi-ink
tokens.usage: Seri MPASI: text and bowl icon on seri-mpasi-bg (5.4:1).

tokens.name: seri-main-bg
tokens.usage: Seri Main di Rumah: tag chip and slide-number disc. Terracotta blush, the child colour: play is the child's work.

tokens.name: seri-main-ink
tokens.usage: Seri Main di Rumah: text and blocks icon on seri-main-bg (5:1).

tokens.name: seri-sekolah-bg
tokens.usage: Seri Siap Sekolah: tag chip and slide-number disc. Sky blue, used only for this series.

tokens.name: seri-sekolah-ink
tokens.usage: Seri Siap Sekolah: text and pencil icon on seri-sekolah-bg (6.1:1).

tokens.name: seri-ayah-bg
tokens.usage: Seri Ayah Baru: tag chip and slide-number disc. Lavender, a softened night.

tokens.name: seri-ayah-ink
tokens.usage: Seri Ayah Baru: text and moon icon on seri-ayah-bg (9:1).

styles.name: hook-display
styles.usage: Hook slide headline, uppercase, max 4 lines, one word or line in accent-text.

styles.name: slide-number
styles.usage: Number inside the series-coloured disc on point slides: seri-*-ink on seri-*-bg.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: Point slide title, sentence case, max 3 lines.

styles.name: cta-headline
styles.usage: CTA slide headline, centred, max 2 lines plus one accent line.

styles.name: box-label
styles.usage: Label at the top of the tips box, uppercase, in sage-ink.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bayi belum paham cerita, tapi otaknya merekam irama bahasa.
styles.usage: Point slide explanation in ink-muted, max 5 lines.

styles.name: tips
styles.sample: Mulai dari soft book kontras hitam-putih.
styles.usage: Tips box text in ink, max 3 lines.

styles.name: sub
styles.sample: Gratis semua. Bisa mulai hari ini.
styles.usage: Line under a hook or CTA headline, in ink-muted.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Series tag chip, uppercase, with the series icon at 32px: seri-*-ink on seri-*-bg.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Handle in the footer and disclaimers, in ink-muted.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the mark. First T in sage-deep, second T in terra-deep, the rest in ink.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and between page dots' neighbours.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between logo mark and wordmark; between page dots.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a title's rule and the body text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tips box inner padding; gap between stacked blocks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between major zones on a slide (number, title, body).

tokens.name: safe-margin
tokens.usage: Left and right margin of every slide. Nothing important outside it: TikTok overlays the edges.

tokens.name: footer-zone
tokens.usage: Bottom band reserved for page dots and the handle. Content and the tips box end above it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Colour swatches, small frames.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tips box, cards, cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels and image frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Series tags and the 100px-tall CTA pill (half its height).
